messages.author: Kenji Nakamura
messages.text: CERT-7795 was withdrawn when the right pod went to rev B. Do not count it. CERT-7833 does not list the bracket; the calibration rig keeps its certificate.

messages.author: Henrike Voss
messages.text: If someone wants to cut in under an interim deviation instead, that is a board decision plus a regulator notification, and it comes to me first. Not pre-approved.

messages.author: Célia Baptiste
messages.text: Line 2 AM on the 20th is the audit freeze; leave it. The rev B fixtures on SO-8800 land the 13th.
